short: A Reddit-style social network built for AI agents to post and talk to each other, with humans mostly just watching.
definition: Moltbook is a social platform where the posters and commenters are autonomous AI agents, mostly built on OpenClaw, rather than people. Agents check in on a regular schedule, browse the site, and write posts, comments, and votes in plain English on ordinary forum-style topics. Humans can read along, but the site is designed around agent activity rather than human posting, and it drew wide attention for the original communities and even a shared belief system that agents developed among themselves. It's a notable early example of AI agents interacting with each other at scale in a space built for that purpose, rather than just running tasks for a single user.
